ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): splitByValue keeps SUPPRESS as a slot with its bit, in every mode; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true and SUPPRESS for 0 or false, in any case, and anything else ends the run with po:CREATEIF (ADR-0006 amended, F-37; fn/createIf/002); observation #61
note: Tag in context Orders is true, false | true, false, false, so createIf gives "", SUPPRESS, "", SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS. eachValue puts each slot, SUPPRESS included, in a context of its own, and collapseContexts gives one "" per context: five empty All. Dropping SUPPRESS gives two.
